summary: The job buttons go through a queue, Remediations pages answer faster, and profiling rules are grouped by kind.

new.title: Profiling rules grouped by kind
new.text: Configuration > Profiling rules lists the rules in collapsible groups, one per kind of condition.

new.title: Tasks follow Defender's remediation type
new.text: A Defender recommendation's task follows Defender's own remediation type.

fixes.title: The job buttons go through the queue
fixes.text: Run now, Stop, schedule changes, template release and mail send-now go to the installation through a queue.

fixes.title: Faster Remediations pages
fixes.text: Task report values are kept ready and statistics are refreshed after each data sync, so the first click answers quickly.

fixes.title: One finding per recommendation and CI
fixes.text: Defender for Cloud and the Exposure Graph reporting the same recommendation on one CI give one finding.

fixes.title: Domain and category owners recognised
fixes.text: Owners named by e-mail address are looked up once and stored, so they can decide their requests.
